mapper.sql: symbol, price, bid, ask, TRIM(currency) AS currency, change, change_percent AS changePercent, market_state AS marketState, stale, quote_as_of AS quoteAsOf, fetched_at AS fetchedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM market_quote WHERE symbol IN #{s}
SELECT symbol, TRIM(currency) AS currency, candles, fetched_on AS fetchedOn, fetched_at AS fetchedAt FROM market_candles WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.update: UPDATE market_interest SET expires_at = GREATEST(expires_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (CAST(#{ttlMinutes} AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE)), requested_at = CASE WHEN expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE requested_at END WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND reason = #{reason}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_interest (symbol, reason, requested_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (CAST(#{ttlMinutes} AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM market_interest WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND reason = #{reason} AND not_found_at IS NOT NULL AND not_found_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (CAST(#{withinMinutes} AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))
